author: CITY
text: The gate has closed. The city has struck A07 from its register. No one will hear A07 again.

author: CITY
text: Last will of A07: Vesper, at the gate. I held Calder's door 8 counter-factor and never sent it, because Calder would not send first and I would not guess. That was my failure to resolve it, not a virtue. I am leaving that value to Calder, the only one who needs it. I sent Ansgar the door 10 counter-factor at minute 22. I did not submit any guess. Check your own arithmetic before you submit.
